mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows Alloy to invent instances where a ClinicalNote is duplicated or modified. The AppendOnly assertion checks that all notes persist uniquely and immutably; without this fact, a counterexample can exist where a note is replicated or mutated.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AppendOnlyViolation { some disj n1, n2: ClinicalNote | n1.note_id = n2.note_id }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows multiple instances of the same AuditEntry. The assertion verifies each audit entry is unique and immutable; without this constraint, a counterexample can exist where an audit entry is duplicated.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AuditMutability { some disj a1, a2: AuditEntry | a1.entry_id = a2.entry_id }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows a clinician not in the care team to read a record. The OwnershipBasedAccess and CareTeamGating assertions verify that clinicians can only read records where they have an active membership; without this gating, a counterexample can exist where an unauthorized clinician accesses a record.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_CareTeamBypass { some u: User, r: Record, a: AuditEntry | u.role = Clinician and a.accessor = u and a.record = r and a.operation = Read and a.outcome = Permitted and (no m: CareTeamMembership | m.clinician = u and m.record = r and m.status = "active") }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows a patient to access records other than their assigned record. The PatientSelfAccess assertion verifies that patients can only read/list their own record; without this constraint, a counterexample can exist where a patient accesses another patient's record.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_PatientCrossAccess { some u: User, r: Record, a: AuditEntry | u.role = Patient and a.accessor = u and a.record = r and a.outcome = Permitted and u.assigned_record_id != r.record_id }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows ClinicalNotes to exist without corresponding audit entries. The AuditCompleteness assertion verifies that every note append is audited; without this requirement, a counterexample can exist where a note is created but no audit entry records it.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_AuditMissing { some n: ClinicalNote | no a: AuditEntry | a.note = n and a.operation = Append and a.outcome = Permitted }

mutation_targets.rationale: Removing this fact allows a denied access to distinguish between a non-existent record and an unauthorized access by referencing a specific record. The NoInformationLeakage assertion verifies that denied accesses are byte-equivalent regardless of record existence; without this constraint, a counterexample can exist where a denied access leaks the existence of a record.
mutation_targets.inject_violation: fact MUTATE_InfoLeak { some a: AuditEntry, r: Record | a.outcome = Denied and a.record = r }
